name: Kooriyama Nagisa
source:
Nagisa is an average guy, except he doesn’t know that. In fact, he doesn’t know anything about his past since he lost his memories. His name was presumably given to him by his counselor Yume. However, he thinks it’s too girly and would rather be called by anything else. He lives alone at Himawari Heights and has a precious bike called RUN.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/09/12/natsuyume-nagisa-review/]Micchi's review[/url].]
